about: Everything the mod reads from the player's own Paint the Town Red install at runtime. Nothing here is shipped; each row is read on the player's PC and cached under the Minecraft instance.

columns.what: What this is, in PTR's terms
columns.unityType: Unity class (or file kind) the data comes from
columns.locator: How the mod finds it without hard-coded bundle hashes (they change every PTR update)
columns.fallback: What happens when it is missing or unreadable
columns.verified: Evidence that this row works on the real install (bench name + result), or 'no'

rows.what: Paint the Town Red's install folder
rows.locator: Steam registry SteamPath -> steamapps/libraryfolders.vdf -> each library's steamapps/appmanifest_337320.acf -> installdir; PTRCRAFT_PTR_DIR overrides
rows.fallback: Title screen and in-world notice: 'Paint the Town Red isn't installed' with the Steam store link; the Biker Bar button stays disabled

rows.what: All Addressables bundles and the serialized files (CAB-...) inside each
rows.fallback: Notice 'This Paint the Town Red version can't be read' with the error, mod stays playable as plain Minecraft

rows.what: Addressables catalog: asset path / GUID -> bundle

rows.locator: catalog key Assets/_PaintTheTownRed/Scenes/Levels/BikerBar.unity -> its bundle -> AssetBundle.m_SceneHashes -> CAB name
rows.fields: GameObject, Transform, MeshFilter, MeshRenderer, BoxCollider, MeshCollider, MonoBehaviour (by script class name)

rows.what: Every visible static mesh of the bar: walls, floor, bar counter, tables, stools, bottles, pool table, lights
rows.locator: level_scene objects whose GameObject is active in hierarchy, renderer enabled, mesh set; skipped under Enemy, PTTRPlayer, GameplayUICanvas, ChallengeMode and trigger-only objects
rows.fallback: Level not drawn; collision still loads; notice names the failure
That renderer is skipped and counted in the extraction report

rows.what: Materials: main texture, tint colour, cutout
Textures of the level and the bikers
rows.locator: PPtr from materials; image data inline or in the bundle's .resS node
rows.fields: m_Width, m_Height, m_TextureFormat (DXT1, DXT5, RGBA32, RGB24, ARGB32, Alpha8), image data

rows.what: PTR's own physical collision of the bar
rows.locator: level_scene, active + enabled + not trigger, excluding Enemy/PTTRPlayer subtrees and objects with a non-kinematic Rigidbody that are small props (bottles, glasses, balls)
rows.fields: m_Center, m_Size, m_Mesh, m_IsTrigger, world matrix
rows.fallback: No collision: the player would fall, so the world spawns a glass floor at the spawn height instead

rows.what: Where PTR's own player starts in the Biker Bar
rows.locator: level_scene object with script class PTTRPlayer, its root Transform

rows.what: The 81 people placed in the Biker Bar
rows.locator: level_scene objects with script class Enemy
rows.fields: enemySettings, eAppearance, sittingOnWeapon, maxSpeed, root and bone Transforms (Hips, Spine, Neck, Head, arms, legs, hands, feet)
rows.fallback: No bikers; notice names the failure

rows.what: Per-type numbers: health and damage multipliers, knockout time, size
rows.fields: enemyInstanceSettings.health, attackDamageMultiplier, attackSpeedMultiplier, enemyReceivedDamageMultiplier, knockbackMultiplier, canBeKnockedDown, koTimeMin, koTimeMax, customScaleMin, customScaleMax, eAppearance, rotationSpeed
rows.fallback: npcs sheet defaults (multipliers 1, KO 4-7 s, scale 1)

rows.what: Which outfits and faces each kind of person can have
The outfit and head materials and their textures
rows.fallback: First body material of the Biker appearance

rows.what: PTR's Blockman character: one textured box per bone, UV-mapped onto the outfit atlas
rows.fields: bone names, local transforms, box meshes (24 vertices, uv0), which boxes use the head material
rows.fallback: No bikers drawn (they still fight, drawn as their hitbox outline)
